_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior soffit repaint (combined assessment + prep + prime + finish). Context prefix SFRP (SoFfit RePaint) confirmed — no collision with existing prefixes. TSK_SFIT_* is consumed by NC soffit (37 tasks). TSK_SFRP_* has zero existing usage. MOD_SFRP_* has zero existing usage. Verified against all context_prefixes_in_use: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, XTRM, SFIT, XWIN, TRRP, DRRP, WNRP, XWRP. SFRP is unique.

paintable_items.name: Exterior soffit field surface
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from SF_SOFFIT_EXT_NC_v1. Same physical surface in RP context — horizontal underside eave surface. SF-based (eave depth x roofline perimeter). Covers all soffit substrate types (wood T&G/plywood, fiber cement, vinyl). No phase suffix needed — single combined spec.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_SFIT_* is NC soffit (37 tasks). TSK_SFRP_* has zero existing usage in id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use. SFRP is unique for soffit repaint. Pattern: SF = soffit, RP = repaint.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_SFRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. RP-NEW tasks use SFRP_ prefix. NC DIRECT transfers retain TSK_SFIT_* prefix (24 tasks) for cross-spec consistency. MODIFIED transfers get TSK_SFRP_* prefix (8 tasks) since they have fundamentally different scope/rates.

expected_modules.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Condition assessment module. Visual inspect, adhesion test (ASTM D3359), mildew/algae assessment (soffit-specific priority), moisture probe, caulk assessment, vent condition check. FIXED time tasks per 100 SF. Maps to 'prep' phase (no 'assessment' phase in controlled_enums).
RP-SPECIFIC: Low-pressure wash per elevation (500-800 PSI max, fan tip, mildew detergent). Per-elevation FIXED task, not per-SF. 24-48 hr dry time after wash. NEVER power wash soffit.

Protection setup — landscape/hardscape ground protection (CRITICAL for overhead drip fallout and scraping debris), light fixture masking, fascia/frieze masking (almost always needed in RP — adjacent surfaces are already finished), siding masking (spray only), equipment setup. RRP containment setup when pre_1978 + lead. Partially transfers from NC MOD_SFIT_SETUP.

RP-specific surface prep: mildew/algae biocide treatment (soffit-specific critical task — #1 failure mode prevention), chalk remediation, scrape/feather failing/peeling paint, degloss/scuff sound areas, caulk assess + repair, vent cleaning, vent masking for brush_roll, dust cleanup. Condition-driven task activation.

State-driven + material-driven primer selection. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT: spot prime bare/thin areas only (material-specific). SS_EXT_CHALKING: chalk-binding primer full surface. SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT: spot or full prime (material-specific on exposed areas). SS_EXT_PEELING: full prime. Skip when adhesion is sound and condition is GOOD with no exposed substrate. Brush_roll or spray (non-vented only).
First finish coat — transfers from NC MOD_SFIT_FINISH_1. Brush_roll (default for vented) or spray (non-vented only). Cut-in at fascia and frieze junctions. T&G brush-back on tg_board panels.
Intercoat inspection and maintenance — transfers from NC MOD_SFIT_INTERSTAGE. QT3: spot sand defects only. QT4: full surface sand 220 grit between coats. QT2: skipped (single coat).
Second finish coat — transfers from NC MOD_SFIT_FINISH_2. QT3/QT4 only. Same method constraints as first coat. QT2 skips (single coat).
Final inspection and overhead touch-up — transfers from NC MOD_SFIT_FINAL_INSPECT.
Protection teardown, vent unmask, equipment cleanup, site cleanup, RRP containment teardown (when applicable), customer walkthrough (RP-specific). Partially transfers from NC MOD_SFIT_CLEANUP.

paintscope_keys.description: Net paintable soffit field area (eave depth x roofline perimeter). Same input as NC spec.
paintscope_keys.notes: Proposed by NC resolution. Shared between NC and RP soffit specs.

paintscope_keys.description: Total elevation count. Drives per-elevation fixed tasks (wash, RRP containment setup/teardown).
Per-elevation access type (ground/ladder/scaffold/lift). Height modifier stacks on top of overhead-adjusted base rates.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared across exterior specs. Soffit is ALWAYS elevated — ground tier applies only to very low eaves.

paintscope_keys.description: Exterior substrate state: SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT, SS_EXT_CHALKING, SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT, SS_EXT_PEELING. Worst-state-wins per v1.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared across all exterior RP specs. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT is the most common soffit RP state (sheltered surface). Maps to condition scale: GOOD/FAIR/POOR.

paintscope_keys.description: Soffit vent construction type (vented/non_vented). Gates spray eligibility. Default: vented.
paintscope_keys.notes: Proposed by NC resolution. Shared between NC and RP soffit specs. Spray PROHIBITED on vented soffit.

paintscope_keys.description: Soffit panel/board construction type (solid_panel/tg_board). Drives T&G joint complexity modifier.
paintscope_keys.notes: Proposed by NC resolution. Shared between NC and RP soffit specs. Physical characteristic unchanged between NC and RP.

paintscope_keys.description: Soffit substrate material type (wood/fiber_cement/vinyl). Drives primer chemistry on exposed areas where paint has failed.
paintscope_keys.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: NC spec uses substrate_material as a configuration dimension. RP needs this as a PaintScope input to drive primer chemistry on exposed substrate areas. Per-project — mixed soffit substrate types are uncommon.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag: home built before 1978. Triggers RRP lead-safe module. Project-level flag.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared across all exterior RP specs. Overhead scraping on pre-1978 soffit is HIGH-RISK for lead dust exposure.

paintscope_keys.description: Landscape/ground protection area below soffit work zone. CRITICAL for overhead work — gravity pulls all drips and scraping debris straight down.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared across exterior specs. Upgrades to full_cover for spray or RRP.

paintscope_keys.description: Walkway/patio protection area below soffit work zone. Drop cloth runners.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared across exterior specs. Upgrades to full_cover for spray or RRP.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of soffit-mounted light fixtures to mask (recessed lights, porch fixtures).

quality_tier.notes: QT5 excluded — soffit is a utilitarian overhead field surface, not fine-finish millwork. Per Exterior_Substrates_Doctrine §5.4. QT2=economy (single finish coat). QT3=standard (2 finish coats). QT4=premium (2 finish coats + full intercoat sand + premium materials). QT modifiers: QT2=1.0x, QT3=1.0x (baseline), QT4=1.3x on qt_scaled tasks.

application_method.notes: brush_roll is PRIMARY default — valid for all soffit types (vented and non-vented). spray is CONDITIONAL on vent_type = non_vented. Spray PROHIBITED on vented soffit (FM-003). spray_backroll NOT valid — overhead back-rolling is impractical. Unchanged from NC.

sheen.notes: Flat (default, most common soffit sheen) or satin. No semi-gloss or gloss — overhead surfaces show imperfections at higher sheen. Unchanged from NC.

phase.notes: Combined assessment + prep + prime + finish RP spec. Assessment tasks map to 'prep' phase (no 'assessment' phase in controlled_enums). No 'apply' phase — uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: SF is primary UOM for soffit field tasks. EA for protection items and light fixtures. LF for caulk repair and cut-in edges. FIXED for per-elevation tasks (wash, RRP containment setup/teardown) and per-project tasks (customer walkthrough). No EA_ROOM — exterior does not use room concept.

substrate_state.notes: 4 exterior RP substrate states — same as SF_TRIM_EXT_RP and SF_WINDOW_EXT_RP. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT is the MOST COMMON soffit RP state (sheltered from UV, long coating life). All input states converge to painted output per selected sheen. Worst-state-wins per v1.

condition_scale.notes: Universal 3-level condition scale. Drives prep pool modifier. GOOD is the expected dominant state for soffit RP. FAIR maps to both chalking (uncommon on soffit) and localized failing paint. POOR maps to active delamination (often at moisture intrusion points).

product_role.notes: Primer = state-driven RP primers (chalk-binding, acrylic, alkali-resistant, bonding) + material-specific spot primers on exposed areas. Finish = QT-driven exterior acrylic systems. Specialty = biocide, VinylSafe IR-reflective coating.

protection_level.notes: edge_only for landscape in brush_roll mode without scraping. full_cover for landscape/hardscape in spray mode or when scraping generates debris. light_mask for adjacent finished fascia/frieze and light fixtures. full_containment for RRP.

typical_relationship.notes: different_finish: fascia, frieze, corner (trim vs soffit colors). same_finish: porch ceiling (often continuous same color).

modifier_mechanism.notes: QT3=baseline (1.0x), QT4=selective_multiplier (1.3x on qt_scaled tasks). Condition modifiers: GOOD=baseline, FAIR=selective_multiplier (1.5x on prep), POOR=selective_multiplier (2.0x on prep). RRP=selective_multiplier (2.0x on prep tasks with paint disturbance).

surface_ids.notes: soffit_field exists in id_registry surface_ids entries_in_active_use (proposed by NC). ext_trim_fascia proposed by SF_TRIM_EXT_NC. ext_trim_frieze, ext_trim_corner, siding_field exist. porch_ceiling proposed (future spec). In RP, all adjacent surfaces are almost always already finished — protection is mandatory.

zone_ids.notes: SF-based landscape area directly below soffit drip zone. CRITICAL for overhead RP — gravity pulls all drips and scraping debris straight down. Upgraded to full_cover for spray or RRP or when scraping generates debris. Shared across exterior specs.
Walkway/hardscape below soffit. Canvas drop cloths for non-slip crew traffic. Upgraded to full_cover for spray or RRP. Shared across exterior specs.
Soffit-mounted fixtures — recessed lights, porch fixtures. Bag or tape. Transferred DIRECT from NC.

Fascia board above soffit — tape + 12-inch masking film at fascia-soffit junction. In RP, fascia is almost always already finished — protection is MANDATORY (unlike NC where fascia may be unfinished). Proposed by NC resolution, reused here.

Siding below soffit at wall junction (frieze area) — protect when siding is already painted. In RP, siding is almost always already finished. Spray upgrades to full masking. Proposed by NC resolution, reused here.

RP-SPECIFIC: General ground protection below soffit work zone. Catches scraping debris, wash runoff, and paint drips. Wider coverage than wall-adjacent protection because overhead debris spreads further. Shared with other exterior RP specs.

RP-SPECIFIC: EPA RRP Rule containment. 6-mil poly extending 10 ft from structure — WIDER than wall containment for overhead scraping debris spread. Required when pre_1978 + lead. Per-elevation setup. Shared across all exterior RP specs.

existing_systems_to_reuse.notes: Reuse NC acrylic primer for spot/full prime on exposed bare wood areas. Same product, spot application in RP vs full surface in NC.
Reuse NC alkali-resistant primer for spot prime on exposed bare fiber cement areas. Required for pH 13.0 substrate.
Reuse NC bonding primer for spot prime on exposed bare vinyl areas. PVC bonding chemistry unchanged.
Reuse NC standard finish at QT2/QT3. Same product, same application. Mildew-resistant formulation recommended.
Reuse NC premium finish at QT4. Same product. Mildew-resistant formulation critical for sheltered soffit.
Reuse NC solar-reflective finish for vinyl soffit with LRV < 55. VinylSafe IR-reflective coating requirement unchanged.

proposed_systems.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Chalking Exterior Soffit
proposed_systems.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Full-surface chalk-binding primer for SS_EXT_CHALKING condition. Penetrates and binds loose chalk to create adhesion surface for topcoat. Required regardless of substrate material — chalk is a paint film problem, not a substrate problem. Reference products: SW PrimeRx Peel Bonding Primer, Zinsser Peel Stop. May share with SYS_PRIMER_EXT_CHALK_BINDING if that exists from trim/window RP — Materials Manager to verify.

proposed_systems.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer for Soffit Repaint
proposed_systems.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Acrylic stain-block adhesion primer for general RP application over feathered and scuff-sanded areas. Full surface for SS_EXT_PEELING, spot for SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT. Different from NC acrylic primer which is for bare substrate — this is for existing paint with adhesion concerns. Reference products: SW PrepRite ProBlock, Zinsser Bulls Eye 1-2-3. May share with SYS_PRIMER_EXT_ACRYLIC_STAINBLOCK from exterior window/trim RP — Materials Manager to verify.

material_system_prefix.notes: 6 NC material systems reused directly (3 substrate-specific primers for exposed areas + 2 QT-driven finishes + 1 conditional solar-reflective). 2 RP-specific primer systems proposed (chalk-binding for SS_EXT_CHALKING + acrylic stain-block for general RP adhesion). NC tannin spot-prime system (SYS_EXT_SFIT_PRIMER_TANNIN_SPOT) NOT needed for RP — knots were sealed during original NC.

proposed_consumables.name: Vent Opening Masking Tape/Foam Plugs
proposed_consumables.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Tape or foam plugs to mask individual soffit vent openings during brush_roll application. Prevents further paint accumulation in vents (FM-006). Used on vented soffit RP only.

proposed_consumables.name: Wire Brush for Vent Cleaning
proposed_consumables.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Wire brush or pick for cleaning paint-clogged vent openings on vented soffit. Used in vent condition assessment and cleaning task.

consumable_prefix.notes: Most consumables reuse existing IDs from NC soffit spec and shared RP consumable pool. CON_DEGLOSS_LIQUID, CON_ASSESSMENT_KIT, CON_BIOCIDE_SOLUTION, CON_SCRAPER_CARBIDE, CON_POLY_SHEETING_6MIL proposed by exterior window RP — reuse those. 2 new soffit-RP-specific consumables for vent masking and cleaning.

proposed_rounds.description: 2 finish coats only — GOOD condition, no prime needed. Sound paint with verified adhesion.
proposed_rounds.notes: Most common RP round for soffit (GOOD is the dominant condition). Skip prime when adhesion verified and existing paint is sound. Cosmetic refresh or color change.

proposed_rounds.description: 1 finish coat only — economy QT2, GOOD condition.
proposed_rounds.notes: Economy single-coat soffit RP on sound paint. Minimum viable scope.

proposed_rounds.description: State-driven prime + 2 finish coats — FAIR/POOR condition requiring primer.
proposed_rounds.notes: Standard RP round for soffit with chalking, failing paint, or peeling. Prime coat is state-driven (chalk-binding for chalking, acrylic stain-block for failing/peeling) + material-specific on exposed areas.

proposed_rounds.description: State-driven prime + 1 finish coat — economy QT2, FAIR/POOR condition.
proposed_rounds.notes: Economy RP with prime needed. Single finish coat on primed surface.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for chalk-binding primer on chalking soffit surface. Thicker-bodied product with lower coverage per gallon than standard acrylic primer.
proposed_profiles.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Chalk-binding primer has lower coverage (~200-300 SF/gal) due to thicker body required for chalk penetration. Overhead application adds wastage factor.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for acrylic stain-block primer on previously painted soffit surface.
proposed_profiles.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Higher coverage than NC primer on bare substrate because RP surfaces are partially sealed by existing paint. ~300-400 SF/gal on previously painted surfaces.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for finish coat on repainted soffit surface.
proposed_profiles.notes: May reuse COV_SFIT_FINISH from NC — Materials Manager to evaluate. Previously painted surfaces have similar coverage to newly primed surfaces.

existing_modifiers_to_reuse.notes: Shared RP modifier. Drives prep pool: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x. Same values as other exterior RP specs. Applies to prep tasks ONLY.

Shared exterior modifier. ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50. Stacks ON TOP of overhead-adjusted base rates (double penalty unique to soffit). Per-elevation attribute. Applies to ALL per-SF tasks in both prep and coating pools.

NC soffit modifier. non_vented=1.00, vented=1.15 on brush_roll application tasks. Transfers unchanged to RP. Spray is PROHIBITED on vented soffit. Research U-002 suggests potentially increasing to ~1.20 for RP to account for vent masking labor — Estimation Engineer to decide.

NC soffit modifier. solid_panel=1.00, tg_board=1.20 on brush_roll application and sand prep tasks. Physical characteristic — transfers unchanged to RP. T&G brush-back tasks already reflect groove work — do NOT apply this modifier to those.

proposed_modifiers.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: RRP modifier for prep tasks involving paint disturbance. no_rrp=1.00, rrp_required=2.00. Binary gate (pre_1978 + lead = activate). Applied to scrape, feather-sand, wash with paint removal, degloss/scuff. NOT applied to assessment, coating, inspection, or cleanup. Calibrated to 2.0x per established exterior RP pattern (RC-001).

NOT a stacking modifier — all soffit task base rates already include ~25-35% overhead penalty from vertical baselines. Documented here for reference. Follows NC pattern: FAC_SFIT_OVERHEAD in NC resolution is also baked into rates, not applied as separate multiplier.

prep_pool.formula: condition_modifier x rrp_modifier x access_modifier x vent_modifier x tg_modifier
prep_pool.max_theoretical: POOR(2.0) x RRP(2.0) x scaffold(1.60) x vented(1.15) x tg_board(1.20) = 8.83x
prep_pool.flag_note: Max theoretical exceeds 4.0x cap — extreme scenario: POOR + RRP + scaffold + vented + T&G. Would never occur in practice (vented T&G soffit on scaffold with lead paint in POOR condition is exceptionally rare). Recommend T&M for this edge case. Realistic worst: FAIR(1.5) x no_RRP(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x vented(1.15) x solid_panel(1.0) = 2.33x (within cap).

coating_pool.formula: qt_modifier x access_modifier x vent_modifier x tg_modifier
coating_pool.max_theoretical: QT4(1.3) x scaffold(1.60) x vented(1.15) x tg_board(1.20) = 2.87x
coating_pool.flag_note: Well within 4.0x cap. Common high: QT3(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x vented(1.15) x solid_panel(1.0) = 1.55x (comfortable).

coordination_notes: Soffit RP runs alongside SF_TRIM_EXT_RP which covers fascia and frieze. Caulk at soffit-to-fascia and soffit-to-frieze junctions is THIS spec's responsibility.
Low-pressure wash ownership: per-elevation task. If wash already performed by another spec on same elevation, skip. Cross-spec deduplication rule (U-003).
Landscape/hardscape protection zones shared with SF_TRIM_EXT_RP and SF_SIDING_*_EXT_RP. Protection setup owned by first spec in elevation sequence (U-004).
RRP containment is shared across all exterior RP specs — do not duplicate containment tasks. Per-elevation setup. MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT may be shared module.
Height/access modifiers (FAC_EXT_ACCESS) are per-elevation attributes — one building may have different soffit heights on different elevations.
In RP, all adjacent surfaces (fascia, frieze, siding) are almost always already finished — protection is mandatory for BOTH spray and brush_roll methods.
Porch ceiling continuity: when porch ceiling is continuous with soffit (same color), coordinate edge work at transition with future SF_PORCH_CEILING_EXT_RP.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: RP-NEW tasks MUST use TSK_SFRP_ prefix. NC DIRECT transfers retain TSK_SFIT_ prefix.
RULE 10: ITM_SOFFIT_FIELD MUST be used exactly as listed in this resolution's paintable_items
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Soffit Repaint (Combined Assessment + Prep + Prime + Finish)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for exterior soffit repaint. Covers previously painted soffit field (wood T&G/plywood, fiber cement, vinyl). Distinct scope from NC soffit (SF_SOFFIT_EXT_NC) — RP adds condition assessment, state-driven prep, mildew treatment, and RRP containment.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Soffit Repaint Task Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New context prefix SFRP for exterior soffit RP tasks (~46 total: 24 DIRECT NC transfers under TSK_SFIT_* + 8 MODIFIED + 19 RP_NEW under TSK_SFRP_*). Avoids collision with TSK_SFIT_* (NC soffit, 37 tasks). Verified zero existing usage of TSK_SFRP_* in id_registry.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Soffit Repaint Module Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New module prefix for 10 SFRP modules (assess, wash, setup, prep, prime, finish_1, interstage, finish_2, final_inspect, cleanup). Avoids collision with MOD_SFIT_* (NC soffit, 8 modules).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit Substrate Material Type (ENUM)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-SPECIFIC PaintScope key — captures soffit substrate material (wood/fiber_cement/vinyl). Drives primer chemistry on exposed areas where paint has failed. NC uses substrate_material as a configuration dimension; RP needs it as a PaintScope input because it's assessed per-project.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit Substrate Material Type Input (ENUM)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.SUBSTRATE_TYPE_SOFFIT. ENUM UOM (wood/fiber_cement/vinyl).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Chalking Exterior Soffit
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-SPECIFIC primer system for SS_EXT_CHALKING condition. No existing SYS_ covers soffit-specific chalk-binding primer. May share product with SYS_PRIMER_EXT_CHALK_BINDING from trim/window RP if that exists — Materials Manager to verify and potentially consolidate.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer for Soffit Repaint
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-SPECIFIC acrylic stain-block primer for general RP adhesion on failing/peeling soffit surfaces. Distinct from NC SYS_EXT_SFIT_PRIMER_ACRYLIC which is for bare substrate — this is for existing paint with adhesion concerns. May share with SYS_PRIMER_EXT_ACRYLIC_STAINBLOCK from trim/window RP — Materials Manager to verify.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit RP: 2 Finish Coats (No Prime, GOOD Condition)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP GOOD condition round — skip prime when adhesion verified on sound exterior paint. Most common soffit RP scenario.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit RP: 1 Finish Coat (Economy QT2, GOOD Condition)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Economy single-coat RP on sound paint. Minimum viable scope for soffit.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit RP: State-Driven Prime + 2 Finish Coats (FAIR/POOR Condition)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Standard RP round with condition-driven prime for chalking, failing, or peeling soffit.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Soffit RP: State-Driven Prime + 1 Finish Coat (Economy QT2, FAIR/POOR)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Economy RP with prime needed. QT2 single finish coat on primed surface.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Chalk-Binding Primer Coverage on Chalking Soffit
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific coverage rate — chalk-binding primer has lower coverage (~200-300 SF/gal) due to thicker body.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer Coverage on Painted Soffit
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific coverage rate — primer on previously painted surfaces differs from NC bare-substrate coverage.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Finish Coat Coverage on Repainted Soffit
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific finish coverage. May reuse COV_SFIT_FINISH from NC — Materials Manager to evaluate.

registry_additions_proposed.name: RRP Modifier for Soffit Prep Tasks
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific modifier: 2.0x on prep tasks involving paint disturbance when RRP required. Calibrated per established exterior RP pattern (RC-001). May share with generic FAC_EXT_RRP if one emerges across exterior RP specs.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Vent Opening Masking Tape/Foam Plugs
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Soffit-RP-specific consumable for masking individual vent openings during brush_roll application. Prevents further paint clogging (FM-006). No existing CON_ covers this.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Wire Brush for Vent Cleaning
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Soffit-RP-specific tool for cleaning paint-clogged vent openings. No existing CON_ covers this use case.
